Author: kaldigo
Name: Aetherloom
Description: Inspect Glamourer designs against the current character's carried and stored equipment.
Punchline: Plan outfits from your FFXIV wardrobe.
Changelog: Aetherloom now owns its wardrobe. On first access it migrates outfit contents, folders, tags, favourites and assignments under their existing design IDs. New designs, imports and edits stay local. Linked Glamourer appearances still update from their originals, and Steward reads the same equipment references from the local wardrobe.
